articles.title: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace
articles.snippet: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman agrees with safety concerns regarding AI development, says no initial share sale this year.

articles.title: Nvidia considers $10B investment in potential record Anthropic IPO: Reuters
articles.snippet: Anthropic is said to be seeking to raise as much as $100 billion in the offering, which could value the AI company at about $2 trillion.

articles.title: Metaplanet cuts Series 10 stock pool by 41%, plans Hong Kong subsidiary
articles.snippet: Metaplanet will cut 131.3 million potential shares and form a $1 million Hong Kong subsidiary for trading in Bitcoin, equities and credit products.

articles.title: Morning Minute: AI Agents Cut BTC Quantum Attack Benchmark by 86%
articles.snippet: Crypto majors are shaky ahead of this morning’s CPI print, but onchain is heating up for another big potential weekend.

articles.title: AI Agents Just Slashed the Cost of a Quantum Attack on Bitcoin
articles.snippet: The ECDSA.Fail challenge cut a resource benchmark for one component of a potential quantum attack by 86%.
